title: Coherent comparisons of integer tensor families
statement: For integer tensor families P and Q in monoidal categories, a strong monoidal functor F and an isomorphism F(P(1)) ≅ Q(1), construct isomorphisms F(P(a)) ≅ Q(a) for every integer a. They preserve addition and the unit and are uniquely determined by multiplication and degree one. Compatible comparisons compose, and a faithful braided pullback to a trivial line detects commutativity.

source.place: Tag 03PK; finite Tate line and tensor powers. Categorical coherence is proved from the existing source integer tensor family and pullback adjunction APIs.

from.place: Construction of the root cover, scalar extension and signed tensor comparisons

proof.text: Construct positive comparisons by recursion using multiplication by degree one. For negative degrees use the fully faithful tensor-left functor of the tensor inverse to solve the same successor equation backwards. This constructs actual isomorphisms, without an existence choice.

Prove the successor equation and extend it to arbitrary multiplication by integer induction and the associativity axiom. Cancellation by the invertible degree-one object proves uniqueness. Recover degree zero from the equation in degrees one and zero, so multiplicativity and degree one alone suffice.

Apply this to the mapped family, whose product is the inverse monoidal comparison followed by the mapped product. Naturality of an oplax-compatible composition isomorphism proves the composite multiplication equation. Compare with the constant unit family and use braiding naturality to prove commutativity after a faithful braided functor.

theorem map_iso_mul (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Monoidal] (Q : IntTensorFamily D)
    (h : F.obj (P.obj 1) ≅ Q.obj 1) (a b : ℤ) :
    F.map (P.addIso a b).hom ≫ (iso (P.map F) Q h (a + b)).hom =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F (P.obj a) (P.obj b) ≫
        tensorHom (iso (P.map F) Q h a).hom (iso (P.map F) Q h b).hom ≫
          (Q.addIso a b).hom
